name: Split squat
why: Keepers push off one leg to dive and jump. So strength and balance on one leg matter.

setup.space: About 1.5 m of floor near a wall, for balance if needed.

steps: Take a long step forward. Lift the back heel and stand on the ball of that foot.
Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Bend both knees and lower straight down. Stop when the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front foot to rise. Do all reps, then switch legs.

mistakes.fix: Point the knee over the middle toes.
Lower straight down like a lift in a shaft.
Stop a hand width above the floor.

parent_check: Front knee stays over the foot
Same number of clean reps on both legs
stop_if: Pain in the knee, hip or lower back
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Losing balance again and again (end the set)

easier.variant: Shorter range with one hand on a wall.
easier.use_when: Balance is lost or the front knee wobbles.

harder.variant: Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row, and the owner approves.
